originals.ko: 나는 누군가의 말을 끊지 않는 게 좋겠어
originals.why: This uses torri ar draws, which means 'interrupt'. This LEGO teaches ar draws as 'across' (~를 가로질러), so it is the wrong sense for this basket.
codi twrw means 'make a racket', but the gloss gives codi as 모금하다 ('raise money'). 'codi twrw ar draws y bont' is also odd Welsh, and it does not show the clean 'across' sense this LEGO teaches.
